meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct.reason: Novita serves Meta's open-weight Llama 3.3 70B Instruct checkpoint (listed bf16/FP8 serverless); its 0.135/0.4 rate is below the model's 0.705 median but it is the same model.

qwen/qwen-mt-plus.reason: Novita serves Alibaba's Qwen-MT-Plus machine-translation model (released 2025-07-24, 16K context matches); its 0.25/0.75 rate is the cheaper of the two routes listed for this model.

qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b.reason: Novita serves the exact Qwen3-Embedding-8B checkpoint (HF Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B, feature-extraction, 32k context matches). The 0.07 input price is Novita's own markup over the 0.01 cross-vendor median, not a sign of a different model.
